principles_summary.principle_1_lowest_cost_primitive: Every new artifact uses the lowest-cost mechanism: skills with disable-model-invocation: true cost zero context until invoked; hook costs zero context; templates live under existing KB; no new CLAUDE.md content.
principles_summary.principle_2_path_gating: N/A — no new rules introduced; no path-gated mechanisms used.
principles_summary.principle_3_enforce_when_safety_critical: Three-layer enforcement: Layer 1 (skill-loader policy via disable-model-invocation) + Layer 2 (agent-body AskUserQuestion mandate) + Layer 3 (PreToolUse hook). Each layer independently prevents unintended writes.
principles_summary.principle_4_subagent_isolation_pays_off: issue-capture-author isolates KB-loading + classification + drafting + write into a fresh context window; main session sees only the spawn approval and the written path. Isolation pays for the multi-file read + KB-reference loading.
principles_summary.principle_5_one_source_of_truth: Templates land in KB-documentation-criteria (structural); discipline lives in KB-issue-capture (triggering); approval prompts live in KB-issue-capture/references/approval-prompt-rubric.md (no duplication in agent body). CLAUDE.md untouched.
principles_summary.principle_6_permissions_safety_net: Per-primitive allowed-tools narrowing: KB-issue-capture (Read/Glob/Grep — knowledge-only), capture-issue (Task/AskUserQuestion — spawn-only), issue-capture-author (Read/Glob/Grep/Write/AskUserQuestion — writer-scoped, no Bash, no Edit, no Task). Hook + permissions are safety net not primary control.
principles_summary.principle_7_plugins_for_distribution: Not applicable — single-project; no plugin packaging. Q-CC-3 records future reconsideration.
principles_summary.principle_8_skills_over_commands: Entry point capture-issue is a skill (not a .claude/commands/*.md file) — skills can bundle references, define allowed-tools, be auto-invoked. No migration needed (no legacy command exists).
principles_summary.principle_9_subagent_reasoning_intention: issue-capture-author: model=sonnet (bounded transformation, not cross-cutting), effort=medium (low reasoning load per invocation). Diverges from pipeline-uniform opus/high deliberately. skills: array ABSENT (per F-003; runtime Read/Glob substitutes).

blast_radius_self.broader_blast: The new PreToolUse hook fires on EVERY Task spawn across the project. Mitigations: NFR-1 fast-path (~100ms target) + NFR-2 fail-open. Per codebase-analysis blast_radius for settings.json: every pipeline sub-agent spawn (~30-100 per pipeline run) passes through the hook's discriminator. The fast-path is the load-bearing performance protection.
